requirements.verifier_assertion: tests/test.sh runs `python3 /app/solution.py --config /app/inputs/config.json --assets /app/inputs/assets --out /app/_r2.json` (and `_r3.json`). The solution must live at /app/solution.py and accept --config/--assets/--out.
Config entries drive validation, desired sets, and missing computation — the tool must read id/key/enabled/use_timeline/use_cutscene/required.
Verifier expects {"id": "e_badkey", "reason": "bad_key"} in invalid[]. bad_key is emitted when a key does not start with `cutscene_`.
Verifier's kept/deleted lists are exactly the .playable/.prefab files under the assets root. Other extensions are neither managed nor deleted.
Verifier asserts manual/handmade.playable is NOT in deleted[] and survives on disk; its path is listed in `.handauthored`.
Verifier bans absolute paths (startswith '/') and forbidden tokens {'/app','/home','/volume','zhiheng','http://','https://'} in the report. Also asserts '/' as separator for the relative paths.

Verifier expects invalid[] = [{e_badkey, bad_key}, {e_dup, duplicate_id}, {e_mutex, mutex_flags}]. Reasons are the enum {mutex_flags, bad_key, duplicate_id}. duplicate_id marks every entry carrying that id; per-(id,reason) records are unique.

The exact kept/deleted/missing lists follow from: valid+enabled entries own their required paths; disabled and invalid entries own nothing. Without this, kept/deleted/missing exact-value assertions cannot be met.
Verifier asserts kept[] = ['alpha/clip.playable','alpha/rig.prefab','beta/scene.playable'] — managed files present on disk that are in the desired set.
must_include: kept lists managed files that exist on disk

requirements.verifier_assertion: Verifier asserts deleted[] = ['bad/x.playable','dup/thing.playable','gamma/old.playable','gamma/old.prefab','mutex/m.playable','orphan/stray.prefab'] and that each deleted file is absent from disk. Hand-authored paths are exempted.
must_include: Deleted files are physically removed from disk

requirements.verifier_assertion: Verifier asserts missing = [{id: e_delta, path: delta/missing.playable}] — required paths for valid+enabled entries that are absent from disk, expressed as {id, path}.
must_include: required path that does not exist on disk

requirements.verifier_assertion: Verifier reads /app/result.json expecting keys kept/deleted/missing/invalid, where missing entries are {id, path} objects and invalid entries are {id, reason} objects with reason ∈ {mutex_flags, bad_key, duplicate_id}.
Verifier asserts kept == sorted(kept), deleted == sorted(deleted), missing sorted by (id,path), invalid sorted by (id,reason).

Verifier runs the tool twice more against _r2.json and _r3.json, asserts they are byte-identical, that /app/inputs/assets file listing does not change across those runs, that r2.deleted == [], and that r2.kept remains the original kept list.
must_include: second deleted list must be empty
no files are removed on later runs
